source: Historical Delta Exchange India production BTC/ETH perpetual 1m traded and mark candles
date_system: UTC calendar month (complete months 2025-01 to 2026-10); ledger ISO UTC

assumptions.strategy: 1H EMA20 + Supertrend10,3 stable-direction EMA touch/close, no ATR/volume filter
assumptions.trailing: BTC 100/50 absolute USD; ETH proportional to entry/80000, rounded to exchange tick
assumptions.entry: Next 1H boundary 1m traded open (live bot checks ~10s after bar close), >0.2% divergence rejected
assumptions.fill: Stop trigger on 1m MARK, traded minute CLOSE used as delayed market execution price proxy; gap/flip at minute traded OPEN
assumptions.margin: $100 account per asset, $10 sizing target and 100x notional ceiling; PM shock 1pct unverified
assumptions.costs: 0.05% taker each side +18% GST; no scalper waiver; excludes funding, spread, slippage beyond delayed fill
assumptions.liquidation: No true account PM liquidation model; accounts below $11 cannot initiate new positions
assumptions.intraminute: minute_close causal baseline, alternate hypothetical OHLC and OLHC price paths to show price-order uncertainty
assumptions.wallet_reference: Research-only unconstrained $1000-target notional per position, ignores depletion and negative equity, NOT a fundable investment account
warnings: Historic 1m OHLC cannot reveal order of high and low or true 3s mark polling
1m traded CLOSE is not the actual execution price for an earlier stop trigger
Funding/actual portfolio collateral/liquidation/slippage/latency are not verified
This is production historical data, NOT DEMO testnet history
